metadata.title: These 3 Top Funds Deliver Deep Value<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Your Value Fund Might Hold Amazon. These 3 Managers Are Buying Hard Assets Instead.
Look at the largest holdings of some of the most popular value funds and you might be surprised. Amazon.com, Apple, and Microsoft are the top three of the $84 billion iShares Russell 1000 Value exchange-traded fund, for instance.
